description: This file defines a custom Android FrameLayout named DragFrameLayout that adds drag-and-drop functionality to its child views. It uses ViewDragHelper to manage touch events and view dragging, and includes methods for managing draggable views and a controller callback interface.

classes.name: DragFrameLayout
classes.description: A custom FrameLayout enabling drag-and-drop for child views, managing touch interception and drag events via ViewDragHelper.

methods.name: DragFrameLayout
methods.description: Constructors initializing the DragFrameLayout with context, attributes, style attributes, and creating ViewDragHelper.

methods.name: onInterceptTouchEvent
methods.description: Intercepts touch events for drag gestures using ViewDragHelper.

methods.name: addDragView
methods.description: Adds a view to the list of draggable views.

methods.name: setDragFrameController
methods.description: Sets the controller to notify about drag events.
